newsitem.title: SRI LANKA: Sri Lanka names news privatisation chief.
newsitem.headline: Sri Lanka names news privatisation chief.

text.p: The Sri Lankan government has appointed Mano Tittawella as the new director-general of the Public Enterprises Reform Commission (PERC), the privatisation body, a senior government official said on Friday.
"He will perform the functions of the chief executive officer," the official, who declined to be identified, told Reuters. "The appointment will be effective from April 20."
Tittawella will resign from his current positions as CEO and managing director of brokerage Lanka Securities and as director, business development, Merchant Bank of Sri Lanka, he said.
P.B. Jayasundera, deputy secretary to the Treasury, will remain PERC chairman, while Ananda Weerasinghe, the current director-general, will retire, he added.
Sri Lanka is in the process of selling badly-run or loss-making state firms. The companies being part-privatised include the national carrier Airlanka and Sri Lanka Telecom.
